xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kancheepuram, Tamil Nadu
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: An incident occurred at the Chennai factory where a worker sustained injury while working on power press machine. The Company took all the requisite steps for the treatment and incurred all expenses.The incident was reported as per statute to the Deputy Director of Industrial Safety & Health, Kancheepuram Chennai. As part of the proceedings, the Company represented against the summons from the Hon’ble Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kancheepuram. Order passed at the final hearing by imposing a fine of Rs. 50,000 which was paid by the Company as directed by the Court.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Alleged violation under Section 92 of Alleged violation under Section 92 of The Factories Act, 1948 (the Amended Act 1987) and The Tamilnadu Factories Rules, 1950.
